event: Liam Carter massacres members of the criminal organization Tribula, executing a terrified villain with a chilling smile.
Liam reflects on his past life as a regressor, determined to prevent Caden's death by deviating from the 'original' timeline.
Duke Caden receives a report on the massacre and immediately suspects Liam due to the distinctive killing method.
Caden reflects on his complex relationship with Liam, recalling their first meeting where Liam displayed brutal efficiency despite an innocent demeanor.
Caden realizes Liam has feelings for him and subsequently finds himself falling in love with Liam.
Flashback to Liam's drunken confession and their first sexual encounter, where Liam's unexpected assertiveness and a cryptic statement about 'going back tomorrow' leave Caden bewildered.
